book.name: Matyu
book.title: God tal ol na tongwo ha maing yal Matyu mining bongwo dimia.

content: Yisas yal ta kebering aleng meginungwo awai ol tongwo ha
Ena Yisas pi sipi ala molere, nir digan bani ti hon pirere, iri si hoibi ure, yali nin oong malgi u pa dungwi.

U pa dungure yal ta nibil ole, kebering aling meginungwo aule ire, Yisas mongwo bani ungwi. Ungure Yisas au si ungwo yalhobi God onangwo pamia di pir tongwo maing hanere, nibil ongwo yal i yu di tongwi, “Gir wai ye, kulna pirkio. Ni tal nigi dongwo ol wanga God prin ni tongwiwe, haya kri di ole ni tomua.”
Yu dungure Lo krehaman ha tisa tau nin diriala olere, “Ayo. Yal i God gaung ha si tomia hano.”
Dungure Yisas yalhobi ha nomani si pungwo i yong sina i haya han pa dungwi. Dire yu ditongwi, “Talongure ha gogo dire nomani si mone?

Ni nomani si pinga tal ha oun dome? Tal nigi dongwo ol wanga God prin ni tongwo i kri di ole ni tomua, ditega, kulang pam mo? Te, aire ere malgi po ditega, kulang pame? Aire ere malgi po diteralga kulang panamo? I ta paikinama.
Te na Ari Wang weni molia. Molere God yulang na tongure, ganba bani ari tal nigi dongwo ongure God pring tongwo i kri di olalga han pa dinanua.”
Yu direre, nibil ongwo yal i yu di tongwi, “Aire, er kwiba ire, ere malgi po”. Yu dungure nibil pangwo yal i aire er kwiba ire, ere malgi ongwi.
Omia arihobi tal ongwo i hanere, miling si giri golere mongwi. Molere God ari yulang tomia, wai pire God haang a yuwo olere mongwi.
Yisas yal Matyu na gala dire wo di na tongwo ha

Ena Yisas ere pirere, takisi ingwo yal na hana, Matyu, takisi iga ala ami di molga hangwi. Hanere yu di na tongwi, “Ni urere, na hana wine olere, na dolna bolo.” Yu dungure na aire, Yisas doling bol ogi.

Ena gin ta na oo kepaga ala Yisas homena ne mongwi. Ne mongure, takisi ingwo yal miki ire dire, ha maing pirkungwo ari miki ire dire, urere, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina, homena para tani ne momgi.
Yu ominia Perisi yal tau hanere, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Takisi ingwo yal ire, hana yal ire dire, Yisas kina ereho mole, homena ne momia, talongwo nome?”
Yu dungure Yisas pungwi. Pirere yu ditongwi, “Dokta iwe, ari yamoni mongwo i gaung bani honagi ta ol tekimia, nibil pangwo yalhobi honagi ol tomua.

Ha maing buku God yu di emiraya, Na homena si gal na tenanga taman. Awai honagi habang habang ol na tenangi wai pinaminua. (Hos 6:6) Yu di engworai kere memini pir pa dinana pio. Na iwe, ari tibi mongwo hobi i ku bolalga, taman. Ari ha maing pirkungwo hobi i ku bolala dire yaime wiwa,” dungwi.
Homena mai tongwo ha

Habang ta Yon, nir bil tongwo yali, grang wine ongwo hobi tau Yisas mongwo bani u pa dire yu sirin bol tongwi, “Na yalhobi Perisi yalhobi kina haung ta homena mai tere mominia, ni gran wine ongwo hobi homena mai tekirere, talongure gogo nome?”

Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Al hon inangwo yali gamahobo kina ereho monangure, homena mai tere gumang yaure monam mo? I ta molkinama. Al inangwo yali aule ire, ere banta nangure, gamahobo miling gul sinangure, homena mai tere monamua.”
“Te ari gal goling bali sinangwo bani gal hon bol ere sibirangwo kunu paikinama. Sibirangwo iwe, hon ere bali bir sinamia.

Te ari nir wain hon holere, meme gang mugu goling ali garu dikinamia. Garu dinangure, miing ure, meme gang mugu i si gala dire, nir wain iwe, u ganba bani namia. Ari han pa dire meme gang hon irere, nir wain hon tulangure, meme gang iwe, nir wain i kina mama dinamua,” dungwi.
Yisas Ami kene ongwo yal ta aung si hon e tere, te al ta Yisas gal sina are u wai ongwo ire dire ha
Ena Yisas ha i di te mongure, Yudari kene ongwo yal ta ure ikwi bole yu ditongwi, “Na auna omaga gomia, ni ure gaung bani anana namna wo. Ananga si hon ere aire ya monamua.”
Yu ditere ongure, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina doling bol ongwi.
Ongure al ta, me erin ana holo holo kebena sutani, algi bil molere Yisas mobing holi doling bol ongwi. Pirere, u mobing hol i urere, Yisas galsina angwi.
Airing i are yu nomani si pungwi, “na nibil olgarai, yali galsina obil agarai, gintani wai sinangwo pai dimia,” dipungwi.
Dipire angure, Yisas inaa dire, al i yu ditongwi, “Amagir ye, kulna pirkio. Ni na onangwo u wai nala di pir na tengiwe, u wai onua.” Ditongwo gin iwe, nibil i wai sungwo ya mongwi.
Ena Yisas pi Yudari kene ongwo yaliwe, oo kepangwo ala ongwi. Ongure arihobi u ku bole, hai mere, pegare ole, mugu ba pu dire yu ol mongwi. Yu ol mongure Yisas pi pa dire hangwi.
Hanere, “Ni yalhobi ere maini pio. Ama i ta golkima. Ul pai momia hankino.” Ditongure arihobi Yisas wa gol tongwi.
Wa gol tongure, irang nigi de pirere, arihobi wa kirulu di maini olungwi. Olere Yisas ama pai mongwo bani pirere, aling aki dungure, ama i aire ya mongwi.
Momia Yisas talongwo guung haang iwe, ganba bina holo holi wa dire kunu bengwi.
Yisas omeling gi dungwo yal su te grabeling aa tongwo ta awai ol tongwo ha
Ena Yisas ganba i pisolere, ere banta nala dire ongwi. Ongure omeling gi dungwo yal sutani doling bol ongwi. Pirere gala bir dire, “Debit gangye, milna pir na to.”
Dungure pisole, oo ala ongure, yasuri pi mongwo bani pa dungwi. Pa dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Na ni yasuri omin a pila di ni tenaminga panama, di pin mo?” Dimba, yasuri, “Owa, onanga panamua.”
Dungure yasuri omeling arere, yu ditongwi, “Ni na onangwo pamia dire nomani si pir na tenanga meri na ereyu ol ni teralua.”
Yu dungure gintani omeling pila dungure, talhan para weni hangwi. Hangure Yisas yasuri kraung are yu ditongwi, “Na tal ol ni tegiwe, ari tau ha wai ol tekio.”
Yu ditomba, yasuri pirere, Yisas tal ongwo ha i ha wai ongure, ganba bina holo holi si dina dire, kunu bengwi.
Ena omeling gi dungwo yasuri ere ongure, yal ta kwia nigi dongwo yong sina momia ha mini paikungwo gintani u Yisas mongwo bani pa dungwi.

Pa dungure, Yisas kwia si doling i mena ol tongwi. Ol tomia yal i ha mini pangwi. Yu omiawe, ari miki weni hanere bukunungwi. Bukunere, “Ayo. Isrel ganba bani homa tal ta yu onangwo hankimgirawe,” dungwi.
Dimba, Perisi yalhobi iwe, Yisas tal ongwo i hanere yu ditongwi, “A. Iwe, kwia nigi dongwo singaba yulang tongure, yu omua,” dungwi.
Yisas ari yal al miling pir tongwo ha

Ena Yisas oo bir migi para weni wangwi. Warere Yudari ha maing oo ala pirere, “God kene ol ni tongwo monua,” dire ha maing nir si tongwi. Tere nibil nebona dere mongwo hobi awai ol tongure, u wai ongwi.
Te Yisas molere, nibil nebona dere mongwo hobi kul pire momia, hanere, miling gul simia aki di tenangwo yal ta molkima. Kun sipi sipi hong yal kene olkungwo mongwo meri momia, hangwi.
Hanere grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Homena miling miki weni homia hano. Homiba, homena bulangwo yal ta molkimia, tamangwo, yal sutani momua.
Yu omia ni homena hong yal, God irawe, sirin bol tere yu do. Ni homena hong yal monia, homena bulangwo ari tau i tibi ol na tengere, homena i bulangwo, kunu benamua, di to.”
